question: A 43-year-old man consulted for diarrheal syndrome, and reported among his background 3 pneumonias in adulthood. Which of the following immunological studies should we request ?:

options.opa: Serum immunoglobulin count and antibody production capacity test.
options.opb: Phagocytosis test and oxidative metabolism of neutrophils.
options.opc: Apoptosis test (programmed cell death) in the circulating lymphocytes of the patient.
options.opd: Study of the repertoire and clonality of the T lymphocytes (alpha / beta).
options.ope: In this patient, it would not be appropriate to request any immunological study.

analysis: Given the patient's history of recurrent pneumonias and current diarrheal syndrome, it is important to assess his immune system function. The most relevant immunological study to request in this case would be to evaluate the serum immunoglobulin count and antibody production capacity to assess for possible underlying immunodeficiency.
